THIS CONTRACT AGREEMENT (hereinafter referred to as the " Agreement ") is entered into at Lahore on this [ ● ] day of [ ● ] , 2020, at Lahore by and between: 
 
 [ ● ] , a partnership firm, having its registered office at 94-B/1, M.M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore, Pakistan (hereinafter referred to as the “Employer” which expression shall, where the context so permits, be deemed to mean and includes its successors-in-interest, administrators and assigns) of the first part; 
 
 AND 
 
 [ ● ] , a company registered under the laws of Pakistan, having its registered office at 234 Westwood Colony, Thokar Niaz Baig , Lahore, Pakistan (hereinafter referred to as the “ Contractor ” which expression shall, where the context so permits, be deemed to mean and includes its successors-in-interest, administrators and assigns) of the second part; 
 
 
 (Hereinafter individually referred to as “ Party ” and collectively as “ Parties ”). 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 WHEREAS , the Employer is desirous that certain Works, more specifically contained in the Conditions of Contract, for the construction of [ ● ] , located at Plot No . [ ● ] be executed by the Contractor and has accepted a Tender by the Contractor for the execution and completion of such Works and the remedying of any defects therein. 
 
 NOW this Agreement witnesseth as follows: 
 
 1. In this Agreement words and expressions shall have the same meanings as are respectively assigned to them in the Conditions of Contract. 
 
 2. The documents mentioned hereunder shall constitute the entire agreement and understanding between the Parties and supersede and override any prior agreements, oral or written, between the Parties: 
 
 The Contract Agreement 
 The Appendix A to Tender 
 The Letter of Acceptance 
 The Special Conditions 
 The General Conditions 
 The Drawings 
 The Specifications 
 The Bill of Quantities. 
 Any other documents that may be duly executed by the Parties in accordance with the terms and conditions of the Conditions of Contract. 
 
 3. In consideration of the payments to be made by the Employer to the Contractor as mentioned in the Conditions of Contract, the Contractor hereby covenants with the Employer to execute and complete the Works within the time period stipulated in the Conditions of Contract, in conformity and in all respects with the provisions of the Conditions of Contract. 
 
 4. The Employer hereby covenants to pay the Contractor, in consideration of the execution and completion of the Works as per provisions of the Conditions of Contract, the Contract Price or such other sum as may become payable under the provisions of the Conditions of Contract at the times and in the manner prescribed by the Contract. 
 
 IN WITNESS WHEREOF the Parties hereto have caused this Agreement to be executed on the day and year first before written, having fully understood the conditions set herein, in presence of witnesses.
